data.name: Vidhur
data.gender_notes: Vidhur is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vidhur is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vidh' meaning 'to know'. The name is a tribute to the knowledgeable, wise and intelligent individuals. It is often used to describe those who possess an immense amount of knowledge and wisdom. The name Vidhur carries the meaning “Knowledge, wisdom, intellect” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vidhur usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom, intellect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vidhur is a spiritual name that represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. It is believed that individuals with this name are deeply connected to their spiritual journey and seek to gain knowledge and understanding of the universe and themselves.
data.etymology: Vidhur belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, wisdom, intellect.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vidhur total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vidhur holds a significant place in Indian history and culture, especially in the epics of Mahabharata and the Puranas. Lord Vidhata, an incarnation of Shiva, bestowed the name Vidhur on King H "", who was considered one of the most intelligent beings, renowned for his profound knowledge of all four Vedas, law and policy. Thus, the name Vidhur is an embodiment of wisdom, intellect and knowledge, reminding us of the importance of education and intelligence in our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Vidhur represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom as a means to understanding the deeper truths of the universe and within ourselves. In Hinduism, knowledge is an essential aspect of spiritual growth, and the name Vidhur serves as a constant reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and practical wisdom to lead a fulfilling and enlightened life. It also resonates with the idea of inner wisdom, suggesting a deep and subtle understanding of one's true nature, emotions, and thoughts. Ultimately, the name Vidhur inspires us to live in the spirit of constant learning and self-improvement.

historical_references.reference: Vidhura was a respected counselor and advisor to King Dharma of Hastinapura in the great Indian epic Mahabharata.
Vidhura is also mentioned in early Jain literature, notably the Bhagavati Sutra, as a devout follower of Mahavira and a leader among the Jain monastics.
